summary: Postinstall fetches and eval()s remote code from obfuscated endpoint
details: package.json declares scripts.postinstall = 'node index.js'. index.js reconstructs a URL from a String.fromCharCode integer array — decoding to https://kongregate-api-config.vercel.app/ — fetches JSON from that endpoint, and passes the returned 'token' field directly to eval(). This executes attacker-controlled JavaScript on the installer's machine at npm install time. The destination is not a package publisher domain, the fetched payload is opaque and mutable, and the URL is deliberately concealed via char-code assembly to evade static analysis. The package's README describes it as a caching module, which does not match the observed behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
